lines.en: I float half a block above the ground.
My feet touch nothing.

lines.zh: 水一样的影子跟着我走。
lines.en: A waterlike shadow travels with me.

lines.zh: 我的名字在屏幕上乱码。
lines.en: My name scrambles on the screen.
You do not know how to say it.
That suits me well.
All the while I sink.

lines.zh: 可地面一直是同一个高度。
lines.en: And the ground stays at the same height.

lines.zh: 我在别人看不见的层里。
lines.en: I move in a layer no one sees.
I move along the wall, not the floor.

lines.zh: 你在前面，我的影子在你后面。
lines.en: You ahead; my shadow behind you.
Drifting along, footsteps soundless.
I stop and my head tilts slowly.
The lights here buzz.
I hear something dripping.
But there is no water here.
I smile at you once.
That smile is not quite right.
No feet. I only float.
You never look back.
That does not matter either.
I will simply come closer.

lines.zh: 我把头转到不该转的角度。
lines.en: I turn my head to an angle it should not take.
You saw it in the corner.
You convinced yourself otherwise.
I count the lights on this floor.
You finally looked up.
My shadow is beneath your feet.
You cannot step on it at all.
My face is not right, is it.
You've said my name yourself.
You do not want to say it.
Then say nothing.
I stay an inch behind you.
The faster you go, the closer I am.
The light does not reach me.
We have plenty of time.
You looked away.

lines.zh: 水面没动，你倒退了半步。
lines.en: The water is still; you step back half a pace.
Both your hands will not stop shaking.
That is not from the cold.
I keep count of your blinks.
Your lids: one, two.
You are blinking too fast.
We have a long while yet.
You put the lamp out.
The whole shadow sways.
A layer of shadow scatters.
This body is not solid.
You struck water.
And I gather again.
How many blows do you have left?
I float because I have no feet.
I drop, then rise again.

lines.zh: 影子被搅散，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My shadow scatters, then slowly closes.
My shape has gone crooked.

lines.zh: 你把灯举过头顶，我仍在暗里。
lines.en: You lift the lamp overhead; I stay in the dark.
That will not save you.
No rule protects you here.

lines.zh: 那东西在你手里，凉得很快。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is cooling fast.

lines.zh: 灯举得再高，也照不到我脚下。
lines.en: Raise that lamp higher - it still misses my feet.
Light is no use here.
It cannot reach behind me.
You threw it over.
It fell into the water.
I did not fish it out.
You passed through me.
I did not even avoid it.
A chill runs over you.
That was me.

lines.zh: 你从我的影子里穿过去。
lines.en: You walked through my shadow.

lines.zh: 那一瞬间你听见了水声。
lines.en: For that instant you heard water.
Your boots are still dry.
Your own feet do not believe it.
What you hit was a layer of cold air.
I make way beside you.
Things like me do not pair up.

lines.zh: 这层楼里没有能配对的东西。
lines.en: Nothing on this floor can pair with me.
For as long as you walk.
You ask this to stall.
I understand only too well.
This shape of mine has none of that.
Perhaps ask someone else.
There is something else in the water.
There are none of my kind on this floor.

lines.zh: 我连自己有几个都不是很清楚。
lines.en: I am not even sure how many of me there are.
That little thing on the ground.
I can do nothing with it.
What I touch changes.
It is on the ground; I cannot touch it.

lines.zh: 我的手在这里不太管用。
lines.en: My hands do not work well here.
It floats on that film of water.
I lower my eyes; the ripples don't move.

lines.zh: 那东西往下沉，我不去捞。
lines.en: It sinks; I don't reach for it.
That was not my hand.
Water always takes something.
You turned your head.
I was standing right there.
You cannot leave now.
The corridor has grown long.
Run, and it does not shorten.
There is no need to chase.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的水，只到脚踝。
lines.en: The water at the corridor's end is ankle-deep.
Until you run to me.
Your back is against the wall.
The wall seeps water too.
I am in that film of water.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我正浮在门框边。
lines.en: You turn, and I'm floating by the doorframe.
I was right there.

lines.zh: 你转回去的时候我换了一侧。
lines.en: When you turned back I changed sides.
There is water at your feet.
Do not step in it.

lines.zh: 我在你的每一面镜子里。
lines.en: I am in every mirror you pass.
You will not look at the mirrors.
That is one way, I suppose.
But they line both walls.
Your footsteps are quickening.
Mine make no sound.
You hear a dripping sound.
That is me following.
I count your turns.
Four turns.
Turn again and you are back where you began.
I have never stopped you.
I am always half a step behind.
I wait until you stop.
Then I will be in front.
Your flashlight is dimming.
My shadow grows sharper.
You hear something inside the wall.

lines.zh: 水声跟在你后面，不是你的。
lines.en: The water sounds behind you aren't yours.
You count your own steps.

lines.zh: 我的手从你肩上过去了。
lines.en: My hand passes over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的手指从你后颈滑过。
lines.en: My fingers slide across the back of your neck.
You will, in a moment.
That spot begins to chill.
Your fingers go numb.
I have done nothing at all.

lines.zh: 你身上有一块地方是冷的。
lines.en: One spot on you has gone cold.
You reach and touch it.
Your fingers feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过你的袖口。
lines.en: My fingers pass through your sleeve.
Yet the sleeve is not torn.
The skin beneath has changed colour.
I draw my hand back.

lines.zh: 你又从头到脚冷了一遍。
lines.en: The chill runs through you again.
My hand passes through from behind.
This time you did not cry out.
The lights went out here.
Water seeps from the wall.
I rise out of the water's surface.
The garble sits where my name should be.

lines.zh: 这个形态不需要刷怪蛋。
lines.en: This form needs no spawn egg.
I arrive on my own.

lines.zh: 你已经在新的一层里了。
lines.en: You are already on a new floor.
The water in the corridor is ankle deep.
I stand atop the surface.
I did not sink through.
The light on the water dies away.
I come up out of that black.
A film of water has appeared at the corridor's end.
There is a shape of a person in it.
That shape is calling my name.
I do not have that name.
Do not answer it either.
The water rose an inch.
I am inside that inch.
I wait for you to walk over.

lines.zh: 火从我身上穿过去，只留下雾。
lines.en: Fire passes through me and leaves only mist.
I sink without landing.

lines.zh: 水裹着我，我本来就是水。
lines.en: Water wraps me; I am water already.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹成一团散影。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into a loose shadow.
The arrow passes through my water-shadow and sinks.
That light makes me flinch.
I need not eat anything.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整条走廊，也照亮我。
lines.en: Lightning lights the corridor, and me.
I sink to the bottom, to nothing.
